runner.install_command: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive && apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl && (cd /tmp && curl -fsSLO https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.20.0/node-v24.20.0-linux-x64.tar.gz && echo "855d581f8a4eb1a8117e3426de25fe02770592febcfb31369aee1ffbfee9e8ec  node-v24.20.0-linux-x64.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c - && rm -rf /opt/nodejs && mkdir -p /opt/nodejs && tar -xzf node-v24.20.0-linux-x64.tar.gz -C /opt/nodejs --strip-components=1 && rm -f node-v24.20.0-linux-x64.tar.gz) && ln -sfn /opt/nodejs/bin/node /usr/local/bin/node && ln -sfn /opt/nodejs/bin/npm /usr/local/bin/npm && ln -sfn /opt/nodejs/bin/npx /usr/local/bin/npx && ln -sfn /opt/nodejs/bin/corepack /usr/local/bin/corepack && mkdir -p /opt/npm-cache && chmod 1777 /opt/npm-cache && npm config --location=global set cache /opt/npm-cache && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
runner.env_probe_command: node --input-type=module -e "import { load, dump } from './dist/ymlcodec.mjs'; const d = load('hello: world'); if (d.hello !== 'world') process.exit(1); if (load(dump({ n: 1 })).n !== 1) process.exit(1);"

init_metadata.tech_stack: TypeScript YAML 1.2 parser/serializer for Node.js; Vite/Rollup dist build; tests via node:test; CPU-only

hardware_requirements.summary: This is a CPU-only TypeScript/JavaScript library that parses and serializes YAML 1.2 (with optional YAML 1.1 types). It has no compiled native extensions, no GPU or accelerator requirement, and one declared runtime dependency used only by the command-line entry. A standard Linux, macOS, or Windows host with a current Node.js LTS interpreter and npm is sufficient to install from this repository, run the documented bundle step, and exercise a parse of a one-key mapping against the locally built artifact.

profiles.label: CPU baseline
profiles.description: Build the YAML parser/serializer from this repository's TypeScript sources and run one real load of a one-key mapping against the locally produced ESM artifact.
probes: cd /opt/codingbench/repo && npm run build && node --input-type=module -e "import { load } from './dist/ymlcodec.mjs'; const d = load('answer: 42'); if (d.answer !== 42) process.exit(1);"
profiles.setup_notes: README installation is npm install of the published package. CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) uses Node.js LTS (node-version: lts/*), npm ci, then npm test. package.json has no engines field. Runtime dependency: argparse ^2.0.1 (CLI only). Test runner is Node's built-in node:test; the test script also runs lint, build, tsc --noEmit, examples as tests, and fetches the YAML Test Suite before node --test on test/core/**/*.test.mjs and test/spec/*.test.mjs.
profiles.build_notes: package.json build script is node support/build-dist.mjs (Vite lib builds for CJS/ESM plus minified browser UMD/ESM, then rollup-plugin-dts writes dist/ymlcodec.d.ts). Outputs live under dist/. No native compile step.
